messages:
samir: Customer (large payments co) pushed back on CAIQ answers about key custody. They want per-tenant BYOK on Dedicated and confirmation for Private. Also asked about any recurring cost and whether fallback to Redwood keys is automatic. Can we triage?

elly: I can take the CAIQ text updates. Quick check: we previously documented Dedicated as \"customer-managed keys supported in specific Dedicated configs\". Need exact phrasing for rotation and audit events.

thomas: Tech nuance: Hosted = no tenant BYOK today. Dedicated has two supported flows: 1) managed-hosted keys with customer-supplied key material in cloud KMS (we store key references), 2) direct tenant KMS proxy (only for Dedicated with private networking). Private/on-prem = full BYOK via customer KMS/HSM.

samir: Perfect. For the CAIQ entry under M2 (encryption), can we say: \"Redwood supports customer-managed key material for Dedicated (opt-in) and full BYOK for Private deployments. Rotation is controlled by customer KMS; Redwood does not rotate customer key material unless contractually requested. Audit events for key usage are exported to Redwood audit logs; customers must enable KMS-side audit logging for KMS access records.\" Is that too wordy?

elly: That's good, shorten to bullet-friendly sentence in CAIQ. Also mention fallback: \"Fallback to Redwood-managed keys only occurs if customer signs an emergency-key-escrow addendum. Not enabled by default.\"

thomas: Add tech caveat: latency/throughput may vary if using remote KMS (network calls on first token generation + rewrap during migrations). We'll include a perf note.

finance-bot: FinanceNote: preliminary onboarding fee estimate: $18k one-time; ongoing BYOK premium for Dedicated clusters: $1,200/month per cluster. Final numbers require SOW.

samir: Thanks finance-bot. Include that as \"indicative pricing\" only.

elly: I'll mark CAIQ answers with tag [CAIQ-BYOK-2024] and upload draft.

thomas: Security checklist: sec-review-bot flagged SR-3 and HSM attestations needed for Private. Also need a threat model review if they want per-tenant key isolation.

sec-review-bot: SecurityReminder: complete SR-3 and HSM-attestation steps before onboarding. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-onboard.md

samir: Proposed next steps: 1) elly to finalize CAIQ snippet (EOD), 2) thomas to add tech caveats + perf appendix (tomorrow AM), 3) finance to confirm SOW pricing (tomorrow), 4) offer 1-week POC for Dedicated BYOK with a sandbox cluster if customer wants validation.

elly: I'll also add a short \"what we need from customer\" checklist: KMS endpoint details, network allowlist, KMS audit log config, signing certs if using HSM.

thomas: For the POC we'll need a minimal dataset and run a simple throughput test. I'll send a POC checklist template.

samir: Good. If customer insists on automatic fallback during incidents, we'll escalate legal for escrow language. Not allowed without contract addendum.

elly: Uploading draft: https://redwood.internal/drafts/caiq/byok-2024-draft.md and pinging security for review.

finance-bot: Note: cancellation terms for Dedicated BYOK SOW usually include 30-day notice plus pro-rated onboarding amortization.

samir: Great. Closing loop: we'll wait for CAIQ draft + finalized pricing, then send consolidated CAIQ response. Thanks all :pray:
